title: Albums above average length
statementMd:
List albums whose total running time is above the average album running time. Show title and minutes rounded to 1 decimal.

Expected columns: `title`, `minutes`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH a AS (SELECT album_id, SUM(seconds) AS total FROM tracks GROUP BY album_id) SELECT al.title, ROUND(a.total / 60.0, 1) AS minutes FROM a JOIN albums al ON al.id = a.album_id WHERE a.total > (SELECT AVG(total) FROM a);
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
